items.source: Extension of FormHttpMessageConverter, adding support for XML, JSON, Smile, CBOR, Protobuf and Yaml based parts when related libraries are present in the classpath.
items.translation: `FormHttpMessageConverter` 的扩展，当类路径中存在相关库时，增加了对基于 XML、JSON、Smile、CBOR、Protobuf 和 Yaml 的部分的支持。

items.source: Uses of FormHttpMessageConverter in org.springframework.http.converter.support
Uses of FormHttpMessageConverter in org.springframework.web.filter
Provides a comprehensive HttpMessageConverter variant for form handling.
items.translation: 提供用于表单处理的全面的 HttpMessageConverter 变体。

items.source: Provides generic filter base classes allowing for bean-style configuration.
items.translation: 提供通用过滤器基类，支持基于 Bean 的配置。

items.source: Set the converter to use for parsing form content.
items.translation: 设置用于解析表单内容的转换器。
